text: The patch captures calendar/date state inside add_setup, awaits folder selection and waits until the date label shows today. Cleanup resets the pane day. The event helper separately waits for an incomplete iframe document to load and one animation frame before date/time assertions. These waits express different readiness boundaries; they are not proof that an initial complete document or every widget task is settled. No fresh test ran.
title: The Today Pane test moves initialization into awaited setup and waits for displayed state
